main: ^Oh, my dear, you look so scared. What bothers your young soul?
^Ah… I’m… I'm scared, lola. My parents were taken, and...
^Oh, my dear.  War is so cruel to young souls such as you, caught in its crossfire…
^Yes, my dear. When you wish to gain some reprieve, find these and take a rest nearby.
^Do you feel at peace, my dear?
^But what about you? What happened to your family…? Where is Kuya Lee?
^Ah, my son… (her smile drops a little bit) He was on his way home from Mintal last night.
^Would you like to come with me, lola? We can look for him together.
^Oh, my dear, do not worry yourself over me. I will wait for him here, just as I had promised.
^Run along now. I know you have places to be.
^I wish you luck on your journey. If you see my little Lee on the way here, tell him to come home soon.
